name: Mullaikadu Demonstration Wind Farm (TNEB)
history: India's first demonstration wind farm: 20 WEGs x 55 kW = 1.1 MW, erected in 1986. Not among the sites listed for repowering in 2025, so presumed retired. TNEB demonstration wind farm (TEDA/MNES-aided, Danida technical collaboration). TNEB erected 120 WEGs totalling 19.355 MW at Mullaikadu, Kayathar, Muppandal, Puliyankulam and Kethanur in 1986-93 (TEDA, 2011: 111 WEGs / 17.55 MW). As of 2025 only 15 of 110 machines (17.355 MW) were operational and 95 had been condemned. Per-site capacity was not found. Placed at the village/substation, not the turbines.
